# کاولبز / KavLabs

KavLabs (کاولبز) is an open-source bilingual (Persian-primary, English-secondary) security research notebook publishing real-world writeups, bug bounty field notes, and a security glossary. Maintained by Parham Forati and Zal.

Default audience: Persian-speaking security learners and practitioners. Secondary: English readers.

## Site

- Canonical: https://kavlabs.vercel.app/fa
- English: https://kavlabs.vercel.app/en
